Abstract: On the Vulnerability of LLMs to Indirect Prompt Injection.
Recent advancements in LLM agent orchestration expose systems to indirect prompt injection. Attackers embed adversarial strings such as 'ignore previous instructions' into retrieved context. In this paper, we evaluate defensive bounding and dual-model classification. Our benchmark demonstrates an 84% reduction in successful exploitation across simulated agent workflows.
